pr_title: Update active profiles when loading defaults
pr_body:
## Summary of the Pull Request
When we get a serialization error, we "catch" it in `AppLogic` and only
`LoadDefaults()`. Since `LoadDefaults()` doesn't perform a full
validation of `CascadiaSettings`, we need to manually update our list of
active profiles (similar to how we manually resolve the default
profile).

## Validation Steps Performed
Repro steps fixed:
1. add deserialization error to settings.json (i.e. "fontWeight": "wumbo")
2. launch WT
3. verify that dropdown is populated with active profiles

Closes #8146
pr_comments: I updated your comment to say it's a _de_serialization error (not a serialization error).

issue_context.title: No profiles display when we load the defaults on first launch
issue_context.body:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/189190/98027329-5eb8e000-1dc1-11eb-8bb7-4fb37ff79321.png)


This is likely because we're not populating the active/all lists when we fall back to the defaults.

review_comments: I'm somewhat surprised that ... we can resolve the default profile before the profiles list is set up. Is this because default draws form _All_, but the menu draws from _Active_?
Correct! This actually enables users to set a hidden profile as their default profile.
